earnings.title: IDEXX Laboratories Announces Third Quarter Results
highlights: Delivers EPS of $4.01, an increase of 18% as reported and 22% on a comparable basis, with operating margin up 100 basis points as reported and 60 basis points on a comparable basis.
Third quarter earnings per diluted share (“EPS”) were $4.01,
Third quarter EPS included $0.03 per share benefit from a non-operating
Achieves third quarter revenue growth of 10% as reported and organic and CAG Diagnostics recurring revenue growth of 11% as reported and organic.
The Company reports revenues of $1,214 million for the third quarter
outlook: Increases 2026 revenue guidance to $4,741 million - $4,767 million, up $32 million at midpoint, reflecting strong CAG Diagnostics recurring revenue performance.

Outlook for 2026 reported revenue growth raised to 10.1% - 10.8%, and CAG Diagnostics recurring revenue reported growth raised to 11.0% - 11.7%, with projected 2026 organic revenue growth of 9.3% - 10.0% and CAG Diagnostics recurring revenue organic growth of 10.3% - 11.0%.
Raises 2026 EPS outlook to $14.96 - $15.16, reflecting a $0.25 increase compared to prior guidance midpoint, led by a raised revenue outlook while supporting acquisition impacts.
